follow-up time: Between the 2nd and 7th day after birth
cohort: 182 term infants born at Imam Reza Hospital of Mashhad, Iran in 2012.
finding: There was no significant difference in mean bilirubin levels between infants born vaginally and those born via cesarean section.
mod_finding: Neonatal jaundice in term infants was not significantly correlated with mode of delivery.
